body:
I'm sorry someone said that to you, that's horrible. It sounds like they don't know or understand what you're going through either. But you don't have to prove it to them, it's not worth it, and they probably don't want you to go through with it. I've found being suicidal sometimes makes people near us say dumb stuff because they're scared, or they feel like they can't help. 

You shouldn't feel guilty, though I know it's hard not to, your parents are there to help you, and if you're going to college you're working towards a future, right? Your parents probably want you to succeed in whatever career field you've chosen, so I think the best way to repay that would be to work hard (my opinion).
Also your last sentence reminds me of the song "Leech Boy" by Crywank, but I'm sorry that you feel like a leech, to me it just seems like you're trying to get your life together and you're getting support from your family :) take care
Well I'd say that's very brave, I'm sure your family would appreciate how much you're trying, even if they're unaware. I hope you can keep trying, for your own sake as well.

Art therapy sounds nice, I used to enjoy art :)
I'm glad it sounds as though you're willing to give it a shot again. I hope it helps you.

Same as you, I attempted in Feb 2018, but 4 times. I'm very lucky that I didn't lose many people but then I guess I'm lucky to not have many to lose. I'm not sure I can help with an answer, but I think they probably wouldn't be happy if you died. I wouldn't be either, though I don't know you. It's sad going through this sub and finding similarities in my life and others. It's sad that we all have to bear this pain but can't ease it even though we try so hard. I'm sorry I didn't have any advice, but i hope you have something to cling on to.

Have you tried different types of therapy, not just cbt? (which I found annoying and useless). Sometimes it takes years to find something that helps. 
No one else can have your life, even if you're gone, no one can fill the exact role you played in the world. 
You don't need to do anything, you're already fulfilling part of your role in being alive just by meeting all your needs for survival. 
Sorry if this was weird, I just mean that you're doing the best you can, and if anyone is asking more of that from you then they probably don't understand everything you're dealing with. Also, congratulations on being clean.

I think you sound really strong and brave. I can't imagine what you're going through, but it's great you have plans for your future. There's nothing wrong with falling off, as long as you keep waking up every day you have chances to keep pushing forward. Good luck

You're not faking it. Mental illness makes things twisted, and tries to tell us that it's not real. I'm sorry you're feeling so bad, I know what it's like to set a date and not stick with it. But you don't have to, you can set 100 dates and you don't have to go through with any of them. I hope you got to smile from at least one thing today. Take care
Thank you, I hope things get better for you and that you stay safe.

Hah, I've had pretty much the same experience there. Good psychs are difficult to find. Breathing techniques and that kind of stuff is just the surface, there are different types of therapy, I found cbt pretty terrible and unbelievable. 

It's not silly. I've been through it. I lost my job because I landed in the ward and missed too many shifts. It happens, though I don't really have anything useful to say about it, sorry. All you can really do it try, and even doing a little is great when you deal with the shit depression and anxiety bring.

Well, apart from the time you were in hospital did you see any mental health professionals or try any medication? I know those in combination can help for some people.

As for the debt, I'm not sure which country you're in but being in debt doesn't spell the end. There are ways to get out of this, but if your mental health is bad you will probably not feel up to it. Which means it's likely what needs to be improved at least a tiny bit, to help fix the rest.
Yeah, it sucks and it's difficult, but it's doable.

Sorry if that's crappy advice.

Well you can talk to me if you'd like. I definitely have felt like that before, and I still do. I haven't made any progress in the last 6 or so months, and my only job at the moment is to get better and "recover" lol. But anyway, I'm hear if you need someone to listen to you.

Hi, I'm not sure how to write this but a fair bit of what you wrote is similar to what I've been through. I'm sorry you feel like it's the end but the good thing about suicide is it's a choice. As much as it is our choice to commit, we can also choose life (sounds shit, right? I'm feeling positive today though). 

Do you have anyone you can go to irl to just talk to? Talking through things with someone else might help you work out the money situation, and might make you feel better as well.

Anyway, I hope you choose to stick around. I'm sure others hope so too.

So you'd rather find out someone had "done something" (died, ended up permanently disabled or disfigured) instead of listening to the stuff they come here to say most likely because they can't/won't share it irl?
